name: story-slider
description: Customer-story slider: quote copy beside a large photo or video, with arrows, a progress rule, dots and a view-all link below. Live: #ap-*-case on the product pages (apc-*) and #ap-gov-case on the industry hubs.

items.description: Slides. Each: quote (required); optional title, author, role (line breaks kept), image, image_alt, logo, logo_alt, logo_w, logo_h, logo_text (a wordmark instead of a logo image; wrap the bold part in *asterisks*), logo_style (hospice|osage|fresenius), link_label, link_url, video_id (YouTube), video_start, video_end, video_title.

quote_icon.description: Quote mark image URL. Empty uses the kit's orange mark.

viewall_label.description: Link beside the controls. Renders only with viewall_url.
